svg.title: Two destinations / Immortals Macau concept floor plan
svg.desc: Four suites, a visible working lab, three assessments, conventional HBOT, public experiences and support. Original shell retained. Furniture illustrative; dimensions and equipment fit unverified.
svg.text: IMMORTALS / MACAU
Two destinations
Four private suites · visible working lab · active public corner · connected circulation
HOW TO READ THE PLAN
Proposed wall
Existing glazing
White = circulation
Tinted = room / public zone
Proposed glazing
DESIGN INTENT
Two wings, one public meeting place.
Left entry: visible lab and lecture forum.
Right entry: the private clinical wing.
G connects the two arrivals.
WINDOWS + PRIVATE CARE
Public café and private suites share the view.
Two window suites and two internal suites.
Two arrivals connected through a hosted hall.
ACTIVE MALL CORNER
Guest lectures and events occupy the tip.
The lab is visible beside the public arrival.
A clear public route runs around support.
CLINICAL + SUPPORT
D1 DEXA / D2 balance / D3 VO₂ max.
T1 HBOT / T2 technical / C1 team / C2 prep.
L1 visible lab / E1 salon / E2 skin-data.
B1-B5 support / W1 accessible WC / W2 WC.
CIRCULATION + DRAWING STATUS
Main guest corridors: 2.4 m clear design target.
Widths and equipment fit require a survey.
Lab services and drainage remain unconfirmed.
Corner glazing and furniture are proposals.
MACAU CLINIC · REPORTED AREA 1,100 m²
TWO DESTINATIONS
Source: supplied footprint. All floor area is assigned to rooms, public space or connected circulation.
Concept drawing only: structure, drainage, fire strategy, equipment and measured dimensions remain for the appointed design team.
